text:
Main samajh sakta hoon ki aap kitne pareshan hain aur aisi halat mein saman milna bohot galat hai. 

System mein abhi bhi iska status "in_transit" dikha raha hai, iska matlab courier partner ne abhi tak delivery update nahi kiya hoga. Lekin aapne jo bataya ki box pichka hua hai aur saman tuta hua hai, uske liye main turant aapka **full refund** initiate kar raha hoon. 

Kya main aapke order ORD-22006 (amount ₹2,199) ke liye refund initiate kar doon?
